__comment: Tiny synthetic 8-sample smoke test, committed to the repo (unlike pyseer_gwas_inputs.json's real-data template) - exercises kinship, association, lineage effects, and covariate scanning end to end via miniwdl, without asserting anything about the (meaningless) synthetic p-values themselves.
__comment_covariates: RST+OspC exercises a multi-column combination in one pyseer run, not just single columns. MLST is deliberately excluded here - on this 8-sample panel it alone already halves the survivable variants (see README), so it would make this fixture's covariate_scan_results non-representative rather than testing anything new about our own WDL logic.
